notes: Hand-authored rendering layout for the map viewer. It never changes exits; see wwwroot/layout.js for how cells are derived from world.json.
Grid cells are [east, north, up]. Region anchors give the seed room's cell; every other room in the region follows from its declared exits.

Regions are groups of rooms connected only by routine exits (elevators, shuttle, long hall, ladder, escape pod, water level). Their relative positions are NOT derived from the game; they are spaced out so nothing overlaps. Adjust anchors as the routine exits get reviewed.
overrides maps a room id to an absolute cell and is applied last. Use it sparingly for rooms whose declared exits do not fit a grid; scripts/check_layout.mjs lists those as misfits.
parking is where rooms unreachable from any seed are lined up.
